Added tests/test_hybrid_main.py with direct calls to __main__.main (coverage) and a subprocess --help test. Covers default paths, --skip-verify, missing spec/golden. hybrid/__main__.py coverage rose from 0% to 81%.
Added parametrized round-trip test for every closed error_class through encode_failure, failure_json, and failure_text. report/errors.py and the error_class closed-set assertion remain covered.

Extended tests/test_cli.py with catalog list/show JSON, generate JSON success, real failure tests (validation, plan_bind, place), and parametrized schema tests for render/lock/verify/internal error classes via monkeypatch. cli/main.py coverage rose from 78% to 88%.

Added error-path tests in tests/test_render.py: RenderError fields, load_unit_source unknown owner/missing source, _source_for_entry explicit source, lookup success, and lookup failure. render/stage_render.py coverage rose to 98%.

Added tests/test_generate_lock.py with LockError field tests, missing pyproject, real uv lock failure with invalid dependency, missing artifact via monkeypatch, and success path. generate/lock.py now 100% covered.

Added tests/test_generate_orchestrate_errors.py covering Render/Lock/Verify/Fsx/generic Exception branches, _purge_build_artifacts symlink preservation, and artifact purge after successful place. generate/orchestrate.py coverage rose to 97%.

Extended tests/test_fsx.py with collision exhaustion, non-directory parent, missing-stage place, and symlink-destination rejection. fsx/stage.py and fsx/place.py error branches now covered except cross-device fallback.
Added test_archetype_not_in_catalog_fails to tests/test_resolve.py using a Catalog instance with the archetype/cli unit filtered out. resolve/compose.py coverage is now 100%.

Added filesystem/package-data error tests to tests/test_catalog_integrity.py: _iter_path_files list/read OSError, _iter_regular_files list/read OSError, and load_default_catalog missing package data. catalog/load.py coverage rose to 93%.
Added parametrized render/template tests to tests/test_render.py covering unknown keys, empty context, repeated/multiple placeholders, and path rendering. render/engine.py now 100% covered.

Added spec edge-case tests to tests/test_spec.py: invalid UTF-8, StringIO stream, unsupported stream payload, stream read OSError, schema bool, description non-string, empty/whitespace profile strings. spec/parse.py and spec/validate.py coverage now 96%/98%.

Extended tests/test_plan_bind.py with PlanBindError str, load_plan_artifact read/json/root errors, dict artifact binding, _nested helper, and canonical JSON ordering/unicode tests. plan/bind.py is now 100% covered.
Rewrote tests/test_purity_imports.py as a parametrized guard covering plan/spec/resolve/catalog/report, asserting none import write-path modules (fsx/generate/cli). All five packages pass.
Extended tests/test_hybrid_snapshot.py with collect_tree missing-root, write_tree replacement, GenerateError wrapping, and existing-destination cleanup tests. hybrid/snapshot.py is now 100% covered.
